findings: Stage 12 repair: nc-02-page05-speaker is not a waterproof narrative-comprehension check. Its immediately preceding p08-t01 demonstration uses the identical portrait-emma/portrait-taro option set in the identical order and explicitly reveals portrait-emma, which is also the scored answer; the learner can repeat the last demonstrated selection without attending to the page-05 story turn. Replace or rebalance the demonstration/control so the scored choice cannot be obtained from the last worked selection or a fixed option-position cue, while preserving the frozen story and learner-language boundary.

Stage 13 repair: the claimed 99-turn base, 99-turn replay, and 226-turn maximum are not executable from the frozen comprehension controls. nc-01 declares four scored_action_sequence actions, and da-01 contributes one teacher prompt, so the six-action comprehension subtotal leaves exactly one turn for nc-02; however nc-02 does not freeze a scored action sequence for replaying p05-t01, displaying its options, and recording the selection, even though its demonstrations count replay, option display, and feedback as separate machine actions and the accounting rule counts each emitted machine control action. Freeze nc-02's exact scored action sequence and then recompute and reconcile the base-path, replay, global maximum, budget predicate, and execution_sequence counts everywhere before review.
